questions.question: Why did the new king of Egypt oppress the Israelites?
options: They demanded their freedom and threatened revolt
They had grown numerous and he feared them
They had sided with Egypt's enemies in war
They refused to worship the gods of Egypt
questions.answer: They had grown numerous and he feared them

questions.question: What did Pharaoh command the Hebrew midwives to do?
options: Teach the Hebrew children Egyptian law
Count all the Hebrew people in Egypt
Free every Hebrew slave at once
